_hinweis: Lerntexte für /stunde (scripts/lernstunde-texte.mjs). Nur "geprueft": true erscheint auf der Website; sonst ein neutraler Text je Phase.

einstieg.bildimpuls.text: Look at the photo. Describe what you see in three sentences.

einstieg.wortigel.text: What comes to mind about “{thema}”? Write down five words.

einstieg.blitzlicht.text: Write one sentence with {vorher}. Then read it out loud.

einstieg.dreifragen.text: Three questions about the last lesson ({vorher}). Answer in your head first, then reveal the answer.

einstieg.wiederholung.text: Revise {grammatik}: write your own sentence for each point.

wortschatz.einfuehren.text: New words: {woerter}. Learn them with the flashcards – with a/an/some and the plural.
wortschatz.einfuehren.bruno: One round of cards, then move on.

wortschatz.erklaeren.text: Revise the words: {woerter}. Do a round of flashcards.

wortschatz.kette.text: Say a sentence with each word from {woerter3}. Then do a round of flashcards.

grammatik.entdecken.text: Look at the sentences for {grammatik}. Can you spot the rule?

grammatik.erklaeren.text: A quick explanation: {grammatik}. Watch the presentation to the end.

grammatik.vertiefung.text: Once more: {grammatik}. Watch out for the typical mistakes.

uebung.einzelarbeit.text: Do the exercises on {grammatik}. Check every answer.

uebung.partner.text: Do the exercises on {grammatik}. Say the sentences out loud as you go.
uebung.partner.bruno: You learn twice as much out loud.

uebung.livequiz.text: Test yourself: the exercises on {grammatik}. Be quick, but accurate.

anwendung.rollenspiel.text: Your goal: {ziele} Write a short conversation: 5–6 sentences, two people.

anwendung.kugellager.text: Your goal: {ziele} Speak for two minutes about it – or write 5 sentences.

anwendung.text.text: Your goal: {ziele} Write a short text: 5–6 sentences.

anwendung.block.text: Show what you can do: {ziele} Write 6–8 sentences.

pruefung.text: Exam practice: {pruefung}. Do this part through to the result.

test.text: Short test: 10 questions on {grammatik3}. Afterwards you will see your result.

abschluss.hausaufgabe.text: For tomorrow: revise the exercises on {grammatik} and the word list.

abschluss.rueckblick.text: What can you do now? Tick what you can do.
